reasons: The constraint 'At most 1 module per semester' conflicts with the requirement to take 4 mandatory courses (CS3263, CS3281, CS2102, CS4277) in the remaining semesters (5, 6, 7, 8). Even if each takes a separate semester, the prerequisite chains and specific semester constraints (CS2102 and CS3281 in Sem 6) make it impossible to fit all required courses without exceeding the 1-module limit or violating prerequisites.
